content:
Settings you would need:

  • View > Sort by > select 'Date', 'Descending' and 'unthreaded'.
  • View > Folders > select 'All'
  • View > Threads > select 'All'

Set up default here:

  • Settings > Appearance
  • Select 'Table View'
  • Default Threading: select 'Unthreaded'
  • Default Sort by: select 'Date'
  • Default Sort Order: select 'Descending'

You can also propagate those settings to all your folders in the account.

  • Select 'All existing folders' and click on 'Choose'
  • where you select 'Folder and it's children' then hover over the account name and then select the account name'.

You would need to repeat that last option for each account.
